prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated production-ready transparent 2D Peony plant sprite, another growth stage of the referenced Flowering identity master for the cozy Anki Garden game. Keep the same matte storybook gouache medium, large readable painted shapes, sage-to-deep-green divided leaf groups, soft organic edges, burgundy-green stems, mild warm upper-right illumination and cool left fill. Clean neutral antialiasing: absolutely no colored fringe, yellow/green/magenta halo, scattered background flecks or translucent holes inside leaves. Main subject opaque; true RGBA transparency outside it. No ground plane, no pot, no soil, no cast shadow, no root below the stem crown, no labels, no text, no border, no watermark, no checkerboard. Whole plant with transparent padding on every side, centered stem crown. Square image. SEED stage: one small rounded chestnut-brown seed with a modest split at its top and a short living burgundy-green shoot emerging upward. Two tiny folded green leaf tips. The seed is matte, tactile, lightly ridged, NOT glossy or metallic; this is an appealing newly germinated seed, NOT a giant bean, bulb, mature stem cutting, or floating seed with long roots. Compact silhouette, about as wide as it is tall. Use generous source resolution; the finished game renders it smaller than all following stages. Keep the entire seed and its short shoot connected, with its underside resting at the centered baseline.
